Package io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request.aggregation

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    MetricSpec
    A metric aggregation spec of a group-by search aggregation, defining an aggregation operation (MetricOps) applied to a field.
    MetricSpec.MetricSpecBuilder
    Builder for MetricSpec.
    OrderByField
    An ordering rule of a group-by search aggregation that sorts the returned groups by a field, either in ascending or descending order.
    OrderByField.OrderByFieldBuilder
    Builder for OrderByField.
    OrderSpec
    An ordering rule of a group-by search aggregation, specifying the sort key, the sort direction, and how null values are handled.
    OrderSpec.OrderSpecBuilder
    Builder for OrderSpec.
    SearchAggregation
    The group-by aggregation spec attached to a search request, which groups the matching entities by one or more fields and optionally computes metrics, orders the groups, returns top hits, and applies nested sub-aggregations.
    SearchAggregation.SearchAggregationBuilder
    Builder for SearchAggregation.
    SortSpec
    A sort rule of a top_hits aggregation, specifying the field to sort by, the sort direction, and how null values are handled.
    SortSpec.SortSpecBuilder
    Builder for SortSpec.
    TopHitsSpec
    The top_hits aggregation spec of a group-by search aggregation, which returns a fixed number of the most relevant hits of each group together with an optional sort rule.
    TopHitsSpec.TopHitsSpecBuilder
    Builder for TopHitsSpec.
  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    AggDirection
    The sort direction used by a group-by search aggregation ordering rule.
    MetricOps
    The metric aggregation operations supported by a group-by search aggregation.
